name: latex-inline
description: Shows the LaTeX math in Claude's replies typeset: as pictures inline with the text in Ghostty, cmux and kitty, and as Unicode text in other terminals

mode.title: How to show math
mode.description: auto (the default) draws pictures in terminals that show kitty-graphics pictures (Ghostty, cmux, kitty; not inside tmux) and writes Unicode text elsewhere. on always draws pictures, text always writes Unicode, off leaves the LaTeX as written.

teach_claude.title: Tell Claude to write math in LaTeX
teach_claude.description: Adds a short section to the system prompt, only where math is drawn as pictures, asking Claude to write formulas as $...$ and $$...$$.

node_path.title: Node.js executable
node_path.description: The node that runs the renderer, as a command on PATH or an absolute path.

font_metrics.title: Terminal font geometry
font_metrics.description: auto (the default) reads your terminal's font from its config (Ghostty, cmux, kitty) and works out the three numbers below the way the terminal does; they apply only when that fails. manual always uses them.

cell_aspect.title: Cell height over width
cell_aspect.description: Your terminal cell's height divided by its width, in pixels. 2.125 is Ghostty's default font, JetBrains Mono at 13pt; Fira Code at 12pt on a Retina display is 2.0. Formulas look stretched when it is off.

baseline.title: Baseline position
baseline.description: Where the text baseline sits in a cell, as a fraction of the cell height from the top: 0.765 for JetBrains Mono at 13pt, 0.767 for Fira Code at 12pt.

line_height.title: Cell height in ems
line_height.description: The cell height in ems of your terminal font: 1.308 for JetBrains Mono at 13pt, 1.25 for Fira Code at 12pt.

math_scale.title: Inline math size
math_scale.description: Inline formula size in ems of your terminal font. Formulas taller than a row take three rows instead of shrinking.

display_scale.title: Display math size
display_scale.description: Display formula ($$...$$) size in ems of your terminal font.

color.title: Math color
color.description: auto follows Claude Code's theme; or a #rrggbb color.
